budgetExceeded: Over the limit by {count} characters. Shorten the session or remove references.
budgetUnavailable: The selected reference budget is unavailable. Complete this check before sending.
INVALID_CONTEXT: The reference fields or revision are invalid.
CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE: The reference library is unavailable. Refresh and try again.
title: References
pickerHint: Up to 8. Revisions are fixed when the session is created.
pickerEmpty: No active references are available for this project.
selectionUnavailable: Some saved references are archived, moved or unavailable. Remove them or refresh before sending.
snapshotHint: These are the exact reference revisions captured when this session was created. Later edits do not change this snapshot.
CONTEXT_CONFLICT: This reference changed. Refresh and reopen it before saving; your edits are still here.
CONTEXT_ARCHIVED: This reference has been archived. Choose another reference.
CONTEXT_PROJECT_MISMATCH: This reference does not belong to the selected project.
CONTEXT_REVISION_CONFLICT: This revision is unavailable. Refresh and review the selection.
CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE: The session and selected references exceed the context limit. Shorten the session or remove a reference.
AUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in again to access these references.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait and try again.
NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE: Unable to complete the request. Check your connection and try again.

space.title: Space memory
space.removeHint: The document will stop appearing in future memory recall. Its revision history remains available.
space.restoreHint: This creates a new revision with the selected content. Later revisions remain available.
space.reloaded: Current revision loaded. Your draft is still here; review it before saving.
space.draftKept: Your draft is kept. Reload the current revision, then review and save your changes.
space.untrusted: Saved during a Run with untrusted input
space.speaker: Speaker: {speaker}
space.MEMORY_CONFLICT: This document changed while you were editing. Your draft is still here.
space.MEMORY_SHARING_DISABLED: Shared memory is disabled for this Agent. Choose This Agent or ask a member to enable sharing.
space.MEMORY_LIMIT: The memory limit has been reached. Remove a document before creating another.
space.UNAVAILABLE: Unable to load or save memory. Try again.
space.invalid: Enter a title and keep the source within 16,000 characters.
space.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the code and copy it manually.

selectionReset: Switching computer or project clears selected references.
